title: Introduction to Machine Learning
topicSummary: Machine learning Basics, Foundational theories, Model building, Model training/testing, Model evaluation.

content.text: This module introduces Machine Learning (ML) as the analytical engine of Urban Informatics.
Objective: Understand how machines learn, build predictive models, and evaluate performance.
Definition: Machine Learning is a subset of AI where systems learn patterns from data and make predictions without explicit programming.

items: Model → Mathematical function mapping X → y

content.text: Machine Learning is built on concepts from:

items: Linear Algebra: Vectors and matrices, data representation.

content.text: y = mx + b Used in linear regression to predict values (e.g., traffic vs time).
MSE = (1/n) * Σ(yi - ŷi)² 👉 Measures how far predictions are from actual values.
Definition: Creating a mathematical model that captures patterns in data.
Steps: Select algorithm → Define features → Define target.
Example: Input (Traffic volume, time) → Output (Predicted congestion level).

items: Training Phase: Model learns from training data.
Testing Phase: Model is evaluated on unseen (test) data.

content.text: 👉 Key Insight: Training captures patterns; Testing checks generalization.
Definition: Assessing how well a model performs.

items: F1 Score: Balance of precision & recall

content.text: End-to-End Pipeline: Data collection → Data cleaning → Feature selection → Model building → Training → Testing → Evaluation → Deployment.
Predict traffic congestion: Input → Time, location, vehicle count | Model → Regression | Output → Congestion level.

examSummary: Machine Learning = learning from data, not explicit programming
Model building → select algorithm, define features (X) and target (y)
Regression metrics = MAE, MSE, RMSE; Classification = Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1
Overfitting = memorizes training data; Underfitting = model too simple
ML Workflow: Collect → Clean → Feature select → Build → Train → Test → Evaluate → Deploy
keyInsight: Week 6 introduces intelligence into systems. 👉 If Week 5 = 'Understand data', Week 6 = 'Predict and automate decisions using data'.
